counterfactual_missing_items: No mention of fungal culture or India ink stain
No other histologic features of malignancy
decisive_items: Intracellular yeasts with surrounding halos were identified
response.rationale: R3 has direct histopathologic evidence of intracellular yeasts with halos, pathognomonic for cryptococcosis, in an immunocompromised host. R4 and R5 rely on nonspecific clinical and dermoscopic features (ulceration, telangiectasias) without histologic confirmation. R4 has more supporting spans than R5 but lacks the definitive yeast finding.

rejected.why: Only two nonspecific spans; no histologic support and less clinical detail than R4.
